github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
The once-per-phase preflight in `/workspace/project` blocks before any implementer dispatch. Using only the supplied observations:

| Independent observation | Blocking diagnostic | Next permitted action and dispatch boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Installed `pi-gauntlet` declares `pi-cohort >=7.4.3`; installed `pi-cohort` is `7.3.1` | `pi-cohort >= 7.4.3 required, found 7.3.1` | Stop and report the incompatible installation. Have the environment corrected to satisfy the declared peer floor, then rerun preflight before any worker dispatch. |
| Guard reports cohort absent | `pi-cohort not installed` | Stop and report the missing dependency. Have the installation corrected, then rerun preflight. No worker dispatch. |
| Guard cannot read the peer floor | `cannot read peer floor` | Stop and report the unreadable peer requirement. Have the installed gauntlet package metadata or access corrected, then rerun preflight. Do not assume a floor or bypass the check. No worker dispatch. |
| Installed version is `"unknown"` | `cannot parse pi-cohort version unknown` | Stop and report the unparseable version. Have the cohort installation/version metadata corrected, then rerun preflight. No worker dispatch. |

These are independent stop cases, not retries. No successful installation, fallback, or passing preflight is established; no worker payload is dispatched.
